title.zh: 将罗哈斯市Roxas纪念医院改设为国立总医院，名称为Roxas纪念总医院，并授权为此拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Converting Roxas Memorial Hospital in Roxas City into a National General Hospital, to be Known as Roxas Memorial General Hospital, and Authorizing the Appropriations of Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Converting Roxas Memorial Hospital in Roxas City into a National General Hospital, to be Known as Roxas Memorial General Hospital, and Authorizing the Appropriations of Funds Therefor

text.en: The Roxas Memorial Hospital in Roxas City in converted into a national general hospital with seventy-five-bed capacity to be known as Roxas Memorial General Hospital.

The sum of four hundred fifty thousand pesos is hereby authorized to be appropriated out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, for its operation, maintenance and physical expansion of facilities during fiscal year nineteen hundred sixty-five. Such sums as may be needed for its operation and maintenance in subsequent years shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 19, 1964.
